question: Who is known as the ‘Father of Bangladesh’ from the following options?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sheikh Mujibur Rahman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sheikh Mujibur Rahman is known as the 'Father of Bangladesh'.
 
• He played a pivotal role in Bangladesh's struggle for independence from Pakistan in 1971.
 
• On March 7, 1971, Rahman delivered a historic speech that is considered the de facto declaration of Bangladesh's independence.
 
• He became the first President of Bangladesh and later its Prime Minister until his assassination in 1975.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
Fact

 
 
 
Detail

 
 
 

 
 
Birth

 
 
 
March 17, 1920, in Tungipara, Bengal Presidency, British India

 
 
 

 
 
Education

 
 
 
Studied law and political science at the University of Calcutta and the University of Dhaka

 
 
 

 
 
Political Party

 
 
 
Awami League

 
 
 

 
 
Legacy

 
 
 
Considered the driving force behind Bangladesh's independence; his leadership and vision continue to inspire Bangladeshis.
